name: @correctiv/desktop
description: EXPERIMENTAL desktop host for the CORRECTIV app — GTK4/Adwaita via gjsify's React-Native layer. A feasibility demonstration, not a release target.

scripts.build: gjsify build src/entry.tsx --app gjs --outfile dist/app.gjs.mjs --define 'process.env.NODE_ENV="production"' --define '__DEV__=false' --exclude-globals navigator
scripts.audio-probe: gjsify build src/debug/audio-probe.ts --app gjs --outfile dist/audio-probe.gjs.mjs --define 'process.env.NODE_ENV="production"' --define '__DEV__=false' --exclude-globals navigator && CORRECTIV_DESKTOP_ASSETS=../mobile gjs -m dist/audio-probe.gjs.mjs
